# AI Kamai
> AI se kamai: AI aur vibe coding se paise kamane wale ke liye digital products, India-first (Hinglish). Built from scratch with AI, zero budget, build-in-public.

AI Kamai is a creator brand selling three digital products, honest-claims only:
- Prompt Vault (₹499): 200 categorized, searchable AI prompts in a web app (not a PDF). Profile auto-fill personalizes [niche]/[service]/[city]. Free sample: 10 best prompts, no payment.
- Agency Launch Kit (₹999): Hinglish playbook to start an AI agency: 25 outreach scripts (DM/WhatsApp/email), objection bank, 12-niche directory, pricing calculator with India benchmarks, templates, 30-day action calendar, delivery system, legal & money basics.
- SaaS Starter Kit (₹4,999): complete multi-tenant SaaS codebase (Next.js 14 + TypeScript + Prisma): auth, customers, invoices, UPI checkout (demo mode out of the box + Razorpay), WhatsApp notifications, 17 tests, full docs. Clone, run 2 commands, deploy in ~15 min.
